limitations: Secondary review: all numbers are quoted from cited sources; cite the originals.
Eq. (1) enthalpy basis ambiguous (kJ mol-1 for a 2-mol NH3 equation); no source given; 45.6 kJ/mol NH3 vs NIST 45.9.
Kinetic model forms given without fitted parameters except Tamaru; Tamaru energy units unstated; LHHW k_F unit dimensionally odd.
Table 3 contains internally inconsistent rows (e.g. Ru/kappa-Al2O3 H2 rate vs conversion and SV).
Inconsistent quoting of Comotti & Frigo 1.4 Nm3/h (NH3 flow in text vs H2 flow in Table 6).
Efficiency definitions differ between cited studies (reforming efficiency up to 112.5 %).
relevance: Context and cross-check source for AmCraX: reaction enthalpy and equilibrium-conversion curves (0.1-3 MPa) for checking the thermodynamics module; catalogue of kinetic-model families with original sources (McCabe 1983 Ni, Tamaru 1988, Itoh 2014 / Zhang 2019 LHHW, Takahashi & Fujitani 2016 Ni/Ru); literature heat-integration benchmark (Realpe et al. 2024: 65.7 -> 75.3 % process efficiency with feed/effluent heat integration and pre-cracker) for the FEHE on/off comparison; reformer efficiency definition (Cha et al. 2021); Pashchenko recommendation of >=20 bar supports the 20 bar baseline. Literature numbers only - never present as AmCraX results.
